notes.1: Complete verified proof of the irrationality of sqrt(2), stated as no rational r satisfies r * r = Rat.2.
notes.4: Complete verified proof of the coordinate-plane Pythagorean theorem: under a concrete R2 orthogonality hypothesis, the squared Euclidean norm of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squared Euclidean norms of the legs.
notes.10: Complete verified proof of Euler's generalization of Fermat's little theorem: if n is nonzero and a is coprime to n, then a^phi(n) is congruent to 1 modulo n.
notes.11: Complete verified wrapper proof of the infinitude of primes: for every natural n, there exists a prime p greater than n.
notes.34: Complete verified proof of the divergence of the harmonic series, stated as non-convergence of the harmonic partial-sum sequence.
notes.42: Complete verified proof of the reciprocal triangular-number identity: the finite sum of 1/T_k for k = 1..n is 2n/(n + 1).
notes.44: Complete verified wrapper proof of the commutative-ring binomial theorem, reusing the official standard-library theorem comm_ring.binomial.binomial.
notes.52: Complete verified proof of the finite powerset theorem: the generated subset list contains exactly the finite subsets of the input finite set and has cardinality 2^n.
notes.58: Complete verified proof of the factorial formula for binomial coefficients, reusing nat.nat_combo.choose_add.
notes.60: Complete verified proof of Bezout's theorem for integers: the gcd of two integers is a nonnegative common divisor and an integer linear combination of them.
notes.63: Complete verified proof of Cantor's theorem: there is no surjection from a type onto its set of subsets.
notes.66: Complete verified wrapper proof of the finite geometric-series formula, reusing the official standard-library theorem ring.geometric_sum.
notes.68: Complete verified proof of the finite arithmetic-series identity: the sum of 0 + ... + (n - 1) is n(n - 1)/2 over Real.
notes.69: Complete verified wrapper proof of the Euclidean GCD algorithm: termination, returned gcd value, and greatest-common-divisor divisibility property.
notes.71: Complete verified proof of Lagrange's theorem for finite groups: the order of a finite subgroup divides the order of the ambient finite group.
notes.74: Complete verified wrapper proof of the natural-number induction principle, reusing nat.nat_base.alt_induction.
notes.80: Complete verified wrapper proof of the fundamental theorem of arithmetic: every positive natural number has a prime factorisation, unique up to permutation.
notes.85: Complete verified proof of the divisibility-by-3 rule for decimal digit lists: the read value is divisible by Int.3 iff the digit sum is divisible by Int.3.
notes.96: Complete verified wrapper proof of inclusion-exclusion for two finite sets, reusing finite_set.finite_set_inclusion_exclusion.
